# Mystic Egypt

> Mystic Egypt is a UK-based tour operator running authentic group and private tours across Egypt — Cairo, Luxor, Aswan, the Nile, Hurghada, Marsa Alam, Siwa, Alexandria, Dahab, Sharm El Sheikh and more — with licensed Egyptologist guides, flights, hotels and full support. Our website is available in English, Arabic and German.
